about:
# Levelbound

**Levelbound** replaces Blizzard's experience and reputation bars with its own. It shows how far you are through the level, how much rested and turn-in XP you have waiting, how fast you're leveling this session, and where the rest of your party is.

Download on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/projects/1715108). Works on Retail and WoW: Forever.

## Experience bar

- Rested XP and XP from completed quests you haven't turned in are drawn on the bar in their own colors.
- The bar tracks your XP per hour for the current session and estimates your time to the next level, pausing while you AFK.
- Time played, time at this level and session time are all available as text or in the tooltip.
- Custom notice for gaining exp.

## Other progress

Levelbound also tracks these, when your game version has them:

- Pet XP
- Reputation
- Honor
- House Favor
- Neighborhood Endeavors
- Trading Post

Put them all on one segmented bar, stack them as connected bars, or place each bar separately with its own size.

## Party markers

Party members who also run Levelbound show up as markers on your XP bar, placed at their own progress toward their next level. Hover a marker for detailed information on their progress and rate. When a party member levels up, you get a notice on screen, a chat line and a sound. Each one can be turned off.

Markers work in 5-player groups, including dungeon finder groups, and hide automatically in raids.

## Sharing

- Shift-click a bar to put a line like `[Levelbound] Level 42 · 63% · 18.4k to go · ~1h 12m at 48k XP/hr` in your chat box.
- `/lb share party` (or `instance`, `raid`, `guild`, `say`) sends the line directly.
- Optionally announce your own level-ups to party or guild, and post an XP summary at the end of a dungeon or delve.

## Customization

In-depth customization options so you can tailor the visuals to your liking.

Open settings with `/lb`, the minimap button or the addon compartment.

`/lb edit` opens edit mode, where you can drag the bars into place.

## Translating

Translations are welcome by pull request. See [TRANSLATING.md](https://github.com/Aeon234/Levelbound/blob/main/TRANSLATING.md).

releases.notes:
# Levelbound

## 1.6.0

Bar text:

- New Color Percent Signs option under Numbers, on by default: a `%` written right after a colored tag, such as
  `[restedpercent:color]%`, now takes the tag's color. The rested and completed-quest shares in the tooltip
  color their `%` the same way.
- All new text is translated into German, Spanish, French, Italian, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and
  Chinese.

## 1.5.0

Profession bars (WoW: Forever):

- Any profession you know can show as an experience bar of its own, after your other bars. Check Show as
  Experience Bar on its card in the profession book, or under the close button of its profession window. The
  choice is kept for each character.
- Each profession has its own color, which you can change on the new Professions page under Progress Types.
  The page also holds the profession bars' shared text and, in Independent layout, their size.
- Clicking a profession bar opens that profession's window, or the profession book for one without a crafting
  window. Its gain indicator shows each skill-up.
- All new text is translated into German, Spanish, French, Italian, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and
  Chinese.

Dungeon summary:

- The Post-Dungeon Summary now ends with how many more runs like it you need to level.
- Dying and releasing no longer restarts the run, so the summary covers the whole dungeon after you run back.
- A reload, or a logout of up to 15 minutes, inside the same dungeon or delve no longer restarts the run. The time
  you were logged out doesn't count toward it.
- All new text is translated into German, Spanish, French, Italian, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and
  Chinese.

## 1.4.0

Visibility:

- Bar text now fades with the bars when Fade Until Hovered is on, including the text above and below Segmented
  and Connected bars.
- New Keep Text Visible option under Fading keeps the text at full opacity while the bars are faded.
- All new text is translated into German, Spanish, French, Italian, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and
  Chinese.

## 1.3.0

Party bars:

- Party Progress can show each member running Levelbound as a bar of their own: set Display to Standalone Bars.
  Choose the width, height, gap and growth direction, fill the bars in class color or the experience gradient, and
  place the stack in edit mode.
- Party bars have their own text, with tags for each member's name, class icon, level, progress, rested and quest
  XP, XP per hour and time to level.
- Compact stacks the bars 1 pixel apart and shows only the text inside them.
- Party bars hide and fade with your bars. Turn off Match Bar Visibility to give them their own.

New looks:

- Pill border: rounded ends and no outline to start. Raise Border Width to add one.
- Iron and Iron Large borders, which hold the bars at a fixed height.
- Edge Glow, off by default: a soft glow in the spark's color and a white trail at the end of each bar's fill.
- Gradient Follows Fill stretches the experience gradient across the fill, so Gradient End is always at its end.
- Class Icon party markers: Circle, Diamond and Ring.

Settings:

- The settings window and edit mode are rebuilt on the settings library Aeon's addons share, with search across
  every page and Undo.
- The Bars settings are now five pages: Layout, Appearance (with the bar preview), Text, Visibility and Gain
  Indicator. Gain Indicator, Party Progress and Level-Ups no longer have tabs; Party Progress shows the sections
  for markers or for standalone bars, depending on Display. Each progress type is one page instead of two tabs.
  `/lb appearance`, `/lb text` and `/lb visibility` open their own pages.
- Pages no longer have a Defaults button. A setting that follows a shared value goes back to it with
  its reset arrow, and the profile's Reset still restores everything.
- In edit mode, each frame has a menu with its position and a shortcut to its settings. Your snap, grid and
  toolbar choices carry over.
- Settings are easier to scan. Options that need another one turned on appear once it is, and options a Match
  setting overrides are hidden while it is on. XP dividers have their own section, Frame Strata moves to
  Advanced, and the gain indicator's offsets sit with its amount text. A bar's own size shows only in Independent
  layout, Stacking shows only in Connected layout, and Fully Visible in Combat is grayed out while Hide in Combat
  is on.
- Clearer names: Copy Text From, Horizontal and Vertical Offset in the text editor, Use Class Color, Wait Until
  Out of Combat for level-up notices, and Print in Chat When Solo, Post to Party and Post to Guild for your own
  level-ups.
- Every settings page has an icon in the sidebar, and Profiles sits below a divider.
- In Segmented layout, the lines between progress types have their own Separator Color. It follows the border's
  color until you change it. Custom Color and Border Color show only when the border style uses them.
- Less text to read: tooltips appear only where they add something the label doesn't say, pages no longer open
  with a summary of their own sections, and a grayed-out option says what it requires or what sets it.

Text and tooltips:

- Times on the bars and in tooltips use the short form chat already used, such as `1h 24m` and `45s`. Times under an
  hour show seconds, such as `18m 4s`, and times of a day or more show days, such as `2d 5h`. Chat lines follow
  the same form.
- New tags on the experience bar: `[name]` for your character's name and `[classicon]` for your class icon. On WoW:
  Forever, `[name:first]` shows only the first name and `[name:short]` adds the surname's initial.
- Experience tooltips are split into Progress, Bonus XP and Pace, with dividers, section titles and small icons.
  Shares of the level line up in a column, and until your first XP gain a note says when pace estimates will appear.

Fixes:

- Percentages round down, so the bar no longer reads 100% (or 100.0%) while you are still short of the next
  level.
- `/lb share` to party, instance, raid or guild during a chat lockdown waits and sends once chat opens again,
  as level-up announcements do. `/lb share say` can't wait, so it tells you to try again instead.
- Names in party level-up notices are the character's real name, not one changed by a disguise or toy.
- The party level-up sound plays on the Master channel, so you hear it with sound effects turned off.
- Logging in or reloading no longer prints the two time played lines in chat. A `/played` you type still shows
  them.
- A profile action that can't go through, such as a name already in use, says why in the settings window instead
  of in chat. Copy Text From confirms what it copied.
- Settings previews size themselves to your current settings, and a gain indicator beside the bar no longer pushes
  it off center.
- In the first-time style picker, the cards fit their text from the start, the previews show sample rates and
  markers that don't cover the text, and the footer says that closing keeps Modern.
- On Retail, party markers and party bars now appear for party members from your own realm.
- All new text is translated into German, Spanish, French, Italian, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and
  Chinese.

## 1.2.1

Fixes:

- Leveling up outside a group no longer raises an "AddOn tried to call the protected function" error. The
  game blocks addons from sending emotes on their own, so Emote Level-Up Message is now Print Level-Up Message and
  shows the line in your own chat instead.

## 1.2.0

Gain indicator:

- The gain indicator can sit to the right or left of its bar, centered on it. Where there is no room beside the
  bar, such as in fullscreen, it sits above that end of the bar instead.
- With segmented bars, gains beside the bar gather in one stack next to the whole row, labeled by type as when
  detached, and grow in the chosen direction.
- A new Animate switch, on by default. Turned off, the indicator and the detached stack appear in place and fade
  without moving.
- A new Animation Style for indicators beside the bar or detached: Rise, as before, or Slide Outward, away from
  the bar. With Slide Outward, the segmented and detached stacks line up side by side instead of on top of each
  other, and the detached stack can grow left or right.
- The Gain Indicator and progress type previews show the indicator beside the bar when it is set there.

Party level-up notices:

- Two new anchors, Right of Bar and Left of Bar, place the notices beside the bar, the first one centered on it.
  Where there is no room beside the bar, they sit above that end of the bar instead.
- The same Animation Style as the gain indicator, for notices beside the bar or detached: Rise, as before, or Slide
  Outward, with the notices side by side growing away from the bar. Detached, they can grow left or right.

Fixes:

- When a type gains again while its line is still in the detached stack, that line moves to the front, so the
  stack's lines fade from the oldest first instead of an older line sliding back before it fades.
- All new text is translated into German, Spanish, French, Italian, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and
  Chinese.

More control:

- XP dividers can mark every 10% or every 5% of a level.
- Party markers can sit on the bar's center, top or bottom edge, with a vertical offset. Top-Edge Notch is now
  Notch and points into the bar from either edge.
- Bar width moves in 1-pixel steps and can go up to your screen's width.
- Text shown on hover now fades in and out.
- Your level-ups are announced as an emote to players nearby while you are not in a group, so others see
  Levelbound in action. It is on by default and can be turned off on the Level-Ups page's Announcements tab.
- Level-up messages in emote, party and guild chat now start with a star icon.

A tidier settings window:

- Settings are split into tabs. Layout, Appearance, Text and Visibility share one Layout page; the Gain
  Indicator, each progress type, Markers and Level-Ups have tabs of their own.
- Every page has a short description under its title.
- A bar's own size and each text slot's style show whether they follow the shared setting, with a button to go
  back to it.
- Previews keep the same size as you change settings, and draw bars at a steady width.
- The Appearance preview replays the gain effect while Gain Shimmer is on; hovering the Markers preview fades the
  markers in as on the real bar.

  border, the end of the fill finds the spark, the space above a bar on the Gain Indicator page finds that bar's
  arrow tint, and a text slot finds its Text row.
- The Markers and Level-Ups previews show the bar without its text.
- Progress types with a single Bar Color show it beside the bar's on/off switch.

- The settings window's content areas are lighter.

## 1.0.0

First release, for Retail and WoW: Forever.

- Experience bar with rested and quest turn-in overlays, XP per hour, time to level and session totals.
- Pet experience, reputation, honor, House Favor, Neighborhood Endeavors and Trading Post bars.
- Three layouts: one segmented bar, connected stacked bars, or independent bars placed one by one in edit mode;
  any of them can stretch across the top or bottom of the screen.
- Editable text on every bar, with live tags such as [percent] and [remaining]; the experience bar has nine text
  places, inside, above and below it.
- Shift-click a bar, or use /lb share, to post its progress in chat.
- Gain indicator: an arrow and the amount gained on each bar, or gathered in one stack away from the bars.
- Party XP markers on your experience bar for group members running Levelbound.
- Party level-up notices on screen and in chat, with a sound; your own level-ups posted to party or guild; a
  summary of the experience and time each dungeon or scenario took.
- Borders (1 Pixel, 2 Pixel, Simple, Simple Thick, Bronze, Metallic), bar textures, fonts, spark, gain shimmer
  and XP dividers, with LibSharedMedia support.
- Fading, focus dimming and combat visibility options.
- A settings window with a live preview on every page; click part of the preview to find its setting.
- Profiles: per-character or shared, with copy, rename, reset, export and import.
- Translated into German, Spanish (Spain and Mexico), French, Italian, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and
  Chinese (Simplified and Traditional).
